lesson: The forecast assigned 99 percent across Nico O'Reilly and Jarell Quansah and omitted Rio Ngumoha, producing a large miss. A nominally near-exhaustive squad-based slate was unsafe for a milestone-debut question because late call-ups and youth players can enter before the deadline. Future first-debutant and replacement markets should reserve meaningful mass for plausible youth or late-addition candidates and avoid binary concentration until the relevant matchday squad is official.
